Interleaved WAL byte frames and page redo records; no append, recovery or semantic-group proof
Bounded extent metadata and reservation identities; no allocation or I/O
Canonical row bytes and versioned row/index cells; no visibility or mutation
Selected DWB control, slot sequence and image validation; no selector or flush effects
Versioned typed table and index definitions; no DDL or visibility effects
Root and before-image chunk expressions, role-preserving edges and release metadata; no undo/reclaim effects
Fixed profile and selected FILEMAP/control expressions; no namespace or reservation effects
